identified.en: placed at Tirumalai hill, Tiruvannamalai district

blurb.en: Rājendra Cola I's list of conquests, cut in his 13th year (1024-25) above a Jaina gift.
blurb.hi: राजेन्द्र चोल प्रथम की विजय-सूची, उनके 13वें वर्ष (1024-25) में एक जैन दान के ऊपर उत्कीर्ण।

reading: Jayasimha of Ratta-padi (1. 6), who was put to flight at Musangi, is the Western Chalukya king Jayasimha II.

page.en: E. Hultzsch, Tirumalai Rock Inscription of Rajendra-Chola I (1908), p. 230
page.hi: E. Hultzsch, Tirumalai Rock Inscription of Rajendra-Chola I (1908), पृ. 230
